verdict.rationale: Reclaim offers Scheduling Links for bookings, so this integration axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zapier integration, and no webhook or CRM push of booking data. The only documented integrations are task-tool syncs (Todoist, Asana, and similar), Slack status sync, and calendar add-ons; none of these route bookings into a CRM or automation stack.

support.subject: As a sales lead, bookings flow into my CRM and automation stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier) without manual copying
